name: Drive 50D II
positioning: Carbon-spoke 50 mm road wheelset with a hooked rim and a 50T star-ratchet hub.

max_pressure.note: Not published on the product page; the maker refers to its user guide.

load_limit.note: Includes rider, bike, gear and accessories.

weight.basis: Pair without tubeless valves and rim tape, although both ship installed.

hub: Elitewheels Kinetic · 50T star ratchet · S&S ceramic bearings

spokes.summary: 4.5 mm bladed carbon · 21F/24R · four spares included

warranty: 3-year carbon rim warranty; carbon spokes are covered for manufacturing defects only.

price_observations.conditions: The store advertises free shipping and customs duties for the US, EU, UK and Australia. Thru-axles are not included.

caveats: Carbon spokes are replaceable but not covered for crash or impact damage under the standard warranty.
Freehub bodies are made by Elitewheels; other brands' freehubs do not fit.
No maximum tire pressure is printed on the product page.
Mainland China price not recorded; confirm it with an authorized seller.
